headline: Southborough officials warned of potential budget cuts or an override for FY28 as Neary School renovation estimates reached up to $40 million.
synopsis: Town officials and the School Committee outlined preliminary FY28 budget plans, warning that avoiding a Proposition 2 1/2 override would require cutting approximately 15 school positions and reducing municipal services. During a public listening session on municipal governance, seniors strongly pushed back against ideas to consolidate the Senior Center into other departments. Meanwhile, architects reported that renovating Neary Elementary School will cost between $33 million and $40 million, far exceeding an earlier $15 million estimate, though the school roof project finished nearly $1.6 million under budget. Southborough also secured up to $632,000 in state grant funding to pay for roughly half of the proposed Fayville Park improvements.

highlights.title: Preliminary FY28 school budget and override warning
highlights.why: Administrators presented a preliminary 5.36% budget increase and warned that avoiding an override would force $1.4 million in reductions and the loss of about 15 staff positions.

highlights.title: Neary School renovation estimates climb to $40 million
highlights.why: Architects demonstrated that realistic Neary renovation options range from $32.9 million to $39.8 million, dispelling an earlier $15 million budget figure as inadequate for needed work.

highlights.title: Seniors reject department consolidation in governance study
highlights.why: Residents and senior center participants strongly opposed any restructuring that would merge the Council on Aging or Senior Center with recreation or youth services.

highlights.title: Fayville Park project awarded $632,000 state grant
highlights.why: The town received a Land and Water Conservation Fund grant covering approximately half of the cost for the proposed splash pad and dog park at Fayville Park.

highlights.title: Neary roof project finishes nearly $1.6 million under budget
highlights.why: The Neary roof replacement reached 97% completion at an estimated cost of $2.91 million, well below its $4.5 million appropriation, reducing town borrowing needs.

looking_ahead.what: Joint meeting with the Select Board on the preliminary FY28 budget
Elementary School Building Committee workshop on site, civil, and septic costs
